templates.description: So sánh trực quan hai đối tượng ngang hàng: mỗi bên có ảnh lớn và nhãn ngắn, phù hợp khi trẻ quan sát hai chủ thể.
A vocabulary learning panel with a title at the top and a horizontal row of fruit images, each labeled with its English name.

Panel with a title at the top and three fruit cards arranged horizontally. Each card shows the fruit image with its English name visible, and a hidden Vietnamese name beneath to serve as the back side of the flashcard.
A simple flashcard layout with a title at the top, a large centered image showing the front side of the card, and a hidden text block below that reveals the back side when interacted.

A vocabulary guessing game panel: title at top, subtitle instruction, three fruit images arranged horizontally in the middle, each with a hidden answer block below that reveals the English name when shown.
Panel with a title at the top, a centered panda image, and a descriptive text block below that lists the foods pandas eat.
